claim: In US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland), the StartExecution API has a bucket size of 1,300 and a refill rate of 300 per second for Standard workflows, and a bucket size of 6,000 and a refill rate of 6,000 per second for Express workflows.
question: StartExecution throttling for Standard vs Express workflows?

qualifiers.scope: StartExecution API, per account, per Region; US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Europe (Ireland)

evidence.quote: | StartExecution — US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), and Europe (Ireland) | 1,300 | 300 | 6,000 | 6,000 |
